# JobLens

> JobLens is a job-market transparency platform. It helps job seekers tell current, actively hiring job listings apart from stale, recycled, duplicated, or uncertain ones.

JobLens collects postings from multiple providers, preserves listing history, groups related postings together, and estimates active-hiring confidence for each listing using posting age, repeated observations, parallel openings, repost history, compensation, and applicant signals. Every score comes with an explanation of the evidence behind it. A high score is not a guarantee that the employer will interview or hire.

## Pages

- [Job search](/): search and filter job listings with active-hiring confidence scores and source history.
- [Profile](/profile): saved jobs, applications, notes, and recently viewed listings for the current browser.
